subject: Discovery follow-up: rotating demo slots across time zones
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: rotating demo slots across time zones

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the call today — really helpful to understand Acme's priorities around scaling search and reducing token costs for your customer-facing assistants. Quick recap:

- Goal: replace current hosted endpoints with a predictable, lower-cost inference stack (mix of hosted + dedicated).
- Key constraints: data residency (EU customers), 99.9% uptime target for live demos, and 100ms p95 latency target for short prompts.
- Technical stakeholders: yourself (platform), Emma (APAC infra), and the analytics team for evals.

Next step: we suggested a technical demo + performance deep dive with Marissa (solutions lead) to walk through the runtime, KV caching, and batching settings. To make scheduling simpler across US / EU / APAC, we usually propose a rotating set of demo slots so the same week alternates to accommodate teammates in all regions.

Proposed rotating slots (pick one; timezone conversions included):

1) Slot A — US morning / EU afternoon
   - Mon/Wed 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET (Tue 01:00 SGT)
2) Slot B — EU morning / US late afternoon
   - Tue/Thu 10:30 CET / 01:30 PT (Tue 18:30 SGT)
3) Slot C — APAC morning / US late evening
   - Wed/Fri 09:00 SGT / Tue/Wed 17:00 PT (Thu 10:00 CET)

If helpful, we can run the demo on a two-week rotation (Week 1: Slot A, Week 2: Slot C, Week 3: Slot B) so everyone sees at least one meeting at a reasonable local time each month.

I've attached a short one-pager (Redwood-Platform-Overview.pdf) and an .ics with the proposed slots. Can you confirm which slot(s) work for you + Emma? Once you confirm, Marissa and I will send a calendar invite with the appropriate deep-dive agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing this.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com
https://redwood.com

From: Liam Chen <liam.chen@acme.com>

Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 18:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up: rotating demo slots across time zones

Camila —

Thanks for the clear recap and the proposed schedule. That rotation idea sounds great. A couple thoughts from our side:

- Emma (cc'd here) will need the APAC-friendly slot (Slot C) most months — we have a critical on-call overlap in the mornings SGT.
- For the EU team, late afternoons CET (Slot A) are usually doable every other week.
- Biweekly rotation would work well for us (keeps meetings predictable).

Can you make the rotation Week 1: Slot A, Week 2: Slot C, Week 3: Slot B, then repeat? That pattern gives Emma a slot every other week and spaces the EU-friendly slot to not always fall at the same time.

I'll confirm exact attendee names after I check with analytics, but we should have ~4 engineers + 2 product folks. Go ahead and send a placeholder invite for the first two sessions and we'll update attendee list in HubSpot after.

Thanks — Liam

--
Liam Chen
Platform Engineering Manager
Acme Inc.
liam.chen@acme.com

Perfect — thanks Liam.

We can do that rotation pattern. I've attached the .ics with two placeholder events for the next four weeks:
- Week 1 (Slot A): Wed 2027-04-07 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET
- Week 2 (Slot C): Wed 2027-04-14 09:00 SGT / 17:00 PT
- Week 3 (Slot B): Wed 2027-04-21 10:30 CET / 01:30 PT
- Week 4 (Slot A): Wed 2027-04-28 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET

Notes:
- Each session will be 45 minutes (demo 25m + tech Q&A 20m).
- Marissa will lead the runtime demo; I'll cover deployment/rollout patterns and cost controls.
- We'll record the session and post a short evaluation checklist afterward.

Marissa — looping you in to confirm availability for these Wednesdays (listed above) and to add any agenda items you'd like.

Liam/Emma — once you confirm the first session (Wed 2027-04-07), I'll send a calendar invite with the full attendee list and the HubSpot link.

Best,
Camila
